info.long_name: Medicaid and CHIP Cancer Screening Rate
info.short_description: Percentage of Medicaid and CHIP beneficiaries who received cancer screening.
info.long_description: State-level cancer screening rates for Medicaid and CHIP beneficiaries, from the Medicaid and CHIP Adult Core Set Quality Measures voluntarily reported by states to CMS (2014–2023). Includes breast cancer screening (BCS: women aged 50–74 who received a mammogram), cervical cancer screening (CCS: women aged 21–64 who received appropriate cervical cancer screening), and colorectal cancer screening (COL: adults aged 50–75 who received appropriate colorectal cancer screening). Reporting is voluntary; not all states report all measures each year.

nccr.name: National Childhood Cancer Registry Explorer (NCCR*Explorer)
nccr.organization: National Cancer Institute (NCI), Childhood Cancer Data Initiative
nccr.location: NCCR*Explorer: An interactive website for NCCR cancer statistics
nccr.description: The National Childhood Cancer Registry (NCCR) is maintained by the National Cancer Institute. NCCR*Explorer provides incidence statistics for cancers among children, adolescents, and young adults ages 0-39 diagnosed from 2001 onward, pooled from up to 29 U.S. cancer registries covering about 76% of that population. Rates are age-adjusted to the 2000 U.S. standard population and reported at the national level only.
nccr.restrictions: Public domain. Data from the National Childhood Cancer Registry, produced by the National Cancer Institute, is generally not subject to copyright restrictions.
